name: Shulker Box Tooltip
summary: Hover over a shulker box in an inventory and hold Shift to see its contents in a preview window, without opening it. Also works for chests, barrels and other containers.
qol: Optional loot table name display (off by default)
Ender chest preview when installed on the server
commands_and_keybinds: Config: Mod Menu gear icon or config/shulkerboxtooltip.json5
getting_started: Hover a shulker box in any inventory and hold Shift.
